claims_checked.statement_checked: Release 0.1.19 contains 6,668 phenopackets; reported corpus totals include 475 diseases, 423 genes, 3,834 distinct variants and 959 publications.
claims_checked.source_locator: Main article pp.1-2 and Table 1; Data and code availability p.5.
claims_checked.finding: Supported as manuscript/release-wide descriptive counts. The paper does not describe our twelve-case sample.
claims_checked.selection_implication: The frozen archive/release provenance is consistent with the paper; no inference that every record or original source is independently scientifically validated.

claims_checked.statement_checked: Curation uses individual-level published case information; aggregate-only descriptions are excluded.
claims_checked.source_locator: Main article p.2 (paragraph beginning There is a need).
claims_checked.finding: Supported as the authors' curation policy. This is not a guarantee against individual-record attribution errors.
claims_checked.selection_implication: Retain existing case-specific/source-support qualifications; this review does not reverse the ZIC3, OFD1 or other source cautions.

claims_checked.statement_checked: SOLVED/CAUSATIVE, HGNC gene identity, explicit hg38 VCF-like fields and GENO zygosity are meaningful source fields for eligibility.
claims_checked.source_locator: Figure S1, Document S1 PDF p.2 / printed p.1; main article pp.3-4.
claims_checked.finding: S1 explicitly shows progressStatus SOLVED, interpretationStatus CAUSATIVE, PAX3/HGNC:8617, hg38 chr2:222297048 G>A, and GENO:0000136 homozygous. Its caption describes pyphetools querying VariantValidator from HGVS to obtain gene, genomic HGVS and VCF-like data.
claims_checked.selection_implication: Supports the field interpretation used in parse_case. This is a representation example, not independent clinical proof or an assurance that all records contain these fields.

claims_checked.statement_checked: Some source variants are qualitative structural descriptions and cannot provide exact small-variant spike coordinates.
claims_checked.source_locator: Figure S2, Document S1 PDF p.3 / printed p.2; main article p.4 Genomic interpretations.
claims_checked.finding: S2 represents ITPR1/HGNC:6180, DEL423kb, SO:1000029 chromosomal_deletion, GENO:0000135 heterozygous, with no vcfRecord or exact breakpoints. The caption defines structural variants here as at least 50 nucleotides. The main-text SLC9A3 gene-deletion example is a different case.
claims_checked.selection_implication: Supports requiring an explicit hg38 record and excluding symbolic/qualitative/large-variant entries. Never manufacture breakpoints or REF/ALT from DEL423kb or gene deletion.

claims_checked.statement_checked: GENO zygosity supports encoding a genotype but not inferring trans phase or a mode of inheritance.
claims_checked.source_locator: Figures S1-S2; selection-plan.json analysis_boundary and prepare.py STATES/vcf_text.
claims_checked.finding: S1 illustrates homozygous GENO:0000136 and S2 heterozygous GENO:0000135. Neither figure establishes phase for two heterozygous variants. Hemizygous GENO:0000134 is not illustrated in these supplements.
claims_checked.selection_implication: Keep observed-genotype strata, unphased 0/1 encoding and explicit phase limitation. This supplement review adds no independent verification of the X strata or hemizygous ontology mapping.

claims_checked.statement_checked: The paper proposes spiking source variants into representative population VCFs for simulated software evaluation.
claims_checked.finding: Supported. This motivates synthetic testing; it does not turn a causal-only VCF into a genome-wide diagnostic benchmark or establish clinical generalisation.
claims_checked.selection_implication: Preserve causal-only spike-ingredient language and distinction from clinical performance.

claims_checked.statement_checked: Source identity and quality checks do not establish independent diagnoses, complete deduplication or freedom from knowledge leakage.
claims_checked.source_locator: Main article p.3 Quality control and Phenopacket and individual IDs; p.4 Discussion.
claims_checked.finding: The article describes format-oriented QC and PMID-prefixed IDs, explicitly warns that one person may appear in multiple publications, and describes Monarch use of phenopackets in HPO annotation.
claims_checked.selection_implication: Schema checks and PMID presence are not scientific adjudication. Possible knowledge leakage is an inference consistent with the HPO use described, not evidence that a particular selected case leaked into this runtime.

claims_checked.statement_checked: The twelve-case quotas, deterministic seed, three-positive-HPO minimum, one-gene/one-or-two-variant restriction, FGFR2/BUB1B exclusions and four phenotype arms follow from the paper.
claims_checked.source_locator: Frozen selection-plan.json and prepare.py; full Document S1.
claims_checked.finding: They are local design choices, not rules or validated parameters supplied by Danis or its supplements. S1-S2 provide two variant-representation examples, no twelve-case evaluation or perturbation study.
claims_checked.selection_implication: Attribute the selection design to the frozen local protocol. Neither supplementary figure tests any of the twelve selected cases or changes frozen source-support groups.

coverage_limits: No supplemental explanatory pages or figures remain unread among the two supplement documents enumerated by the official article XML.
This is a full read of two figure representations and captions, not scientific interpretation of every cell/record in the 6,668-case bank.
No new corpus traversal or independent review of every underlying publication was performed. Existing twelve-case source reviews and source-support limitations remain unchanged.
Figure S1/S2 example cases and their original clinical publications were not separately re-adjudicated.
No runtime-specific leakage test, phase confirmation, pathogenicity reassessment or benchmark-result inspection was performed.
